//: TODO(design): the surface (GAME_DESIGN.md §5.6, §5.7; M4). Working values and texts by Claude; change them freely. The surface is a second map over the underground, the same size; every Passage has its hex on both. Up there the hydra needs Mist: a turn ended without mist under her leaves her Exposed. The Order lives here, in its castle and camps, and keeps Flame Shrines burning; every shrine put out leaves mist that never fades.

generator.//: How the surface is laid out. castle: this many hexes in from the edge, on the far side from the first Passage, on a hill this many hexes round. forest and hills: share of the land, and smoothing (more = bigger blobs). crags: clumps of bare rock nobody crosses ([from, to] clumps, [from, to] hexes each). river: crosses from edge to edge; winding: how much it wanders. flameShrines: how many, at least minApart steps from each other, minFromPassage from any Passage, minFromCastle from the castle; tierByCastleDistance: a shrine this many steps from the castle or closer is one tier stronger, for each number (so [14, 8]: tier 1 far out, tier 2 within 14, tier 3 within 8); groupsByTier: who guards a shrine of each tier (encounter groups from enemies.json, by weight). camps: where the Order sets out from on the surface, with the castle. settlements: by = what they like to stand next to (river, hill or field). finds: things lying about, from the list under finds below. eventSites: hexes where a surface event waits. spacing: objects keep at least this many steps apart.

mist.//: Mist on the map (GAME_DESIGN.md §5.6), counted in turns of daylight it has left. exhale: the Exhale Mist button, for moisture, covers her hex and those within radius (more with a head of a class in radiusByClass) for turns. breatheAhead: walking onto a hex without mist breathes mist onto it first, for moisture, lasting turns; null = no breathing on the way. maxTurns: mist never holds more than this. fade: turns of mist lost every world turn by day and by night; a windy day loses windExtra more (windChance: the chance of a windy day, rolled at dawn). waterFade: over the river mist fades this many times as fast. censerClears: a unit of the Order with a Censer Priest (censerType) clears mist this many hexes round it as it walks (0 = only its own hex). start: at the start, mist lies this far round every Passage for this many turns; the Passage's own hex always has mist. The Drought's faster fading is in world.json runModifiers.

dayNight.//: A day is dayTurns turns long, then a night of nightTurns. At night everyone up there sees nightSight hexes less (the hydra and the Order), and mist fades slower (mist.fade.night).

exposed.//: A world turn ended without mist under her: she is Exposed. She loses bodyHp (never below 1 HP), the Alert rises by alert, and she doesn't heal that turn. crawl: an Exposed hydra (or one with no Moisture to breathe mist ahead) may still crawl one step a turn onto bare ground; false = she can't step off the mist at all. In a battle on the surface while Exposed, her heads deal battleDamagePercent more damage (negative: less).

flameShrines.//: Flame Shrines of the Order (GAME_DESIGN.md §5.7). Stepping onto one means fighting its guard; winning puts it out. Putting one out changes the Alert by alertWhenPutOut and leaves mist that never fades for lastingMistRadius round it. The first shrine a hydra puts out gives one of mutations (mutations.json) with firstMutationChance, every later one with mutationChance. relight: afterTurns world turns later, a party (groupId, from enemies.json) sets out from the nearest camp or the castle, at movement points a turn, to light it again; when they do, the Alert changes by alert, the shrine burns, they guard it, and its mist fades like any other. TODO(design): the win (all shrines out) comes in M7.

order.//: The Order on the surface. sightInMist: how far it sees the hydra when she is in mist; sight: when she is not (shorter at night by dayNight.nightSight). patrols: they set out from the castle and the camps; at most maxByStage at once, by Alert stages reached (first number: none reached yet), the first firstOnTurn world turns after the hydra first climbs up, then a new one every everyTurns; movement in movement points; one that has seen her follows her for chaseTurns turns. groups: encounter groups from enemies.json, by weight; fromStage: only once this Alert stage is reached.

finds.//: Things lying about on the surface; stepping onto one takes it. weight: how often it comes up; unique: at most one in a world. loot: what it gives. revealsHiddenThreshold: it shows where the nearest hidden threshold of the underground is.

milkChurn.name: Milk Churn
milkChurn.text: A churn left by the road. Three heads share it and argue about the skin.

rainBarrel.name: Rain Barrel
rainBarrel.text: A rain barrel behind a shed. It was full. It is now a barrel.

compostHeap.name: Compost Heap
compostHeap.text: A compost heap, still warm. The heads agree it is the best thing up here.

shallowGrave.name: Shallow Grave
shallowGrave.text: A shallow grave. The Order buries heretics shallow, to save on effort.

surveyorsSatchel.name: Surveyor's Satchel
surveyorsSatchel.text: A satchel of the Order's surveyors, with a map of the deep. Someone has circled a crack and written "draughty".

places.//: What the surface's buildings say when the hydra looks at them. Villages, the mill and watchtowers are closed to her in M4 (TODO(design): what she can do there comes later). camp: where surface patrols set out from, with the castle.

castle.name: The Castle of the Eternal Flame
castle.text: The Order's castle. The gate is shut, the walls are high, and somebody on them is already writing down what you look like.

passage.name: Passage
passage.text: A crack between the underground and the sky. The draught smells of hay and lamp oil.

village.name: Village
village.text: A village. The doors are barred and the shutters pulled. A goose watches you with open contempt.

mill.name: Watermill
mill.text: A watermill on the river. The wheel keeps turning, because nobody has told it not to.

watchtower.name: Watchtower
watchtower.text: A watchtower of the Order, on its hill. Empty. The ladder has been pulled up, from the inside, by someone who then left.

camp.name: Camp of the Order
camp.text: A camp of the Order: tents, a flagpole, a duty roster. Patrols set out from here.

flameShrine.name: Flame Shrine
flameShrine.text: A Flame Shrine of the Order. It burns day and night, and is guarded with the same diligence.

flameShrineOut.name: Flame Shrine (put out)
flameShrineOut.text: A cold shrine, full of mist. The Order will want to light it again.

texts.//: What the game says on the surface. {n}: a number; {left}: shrines still burning; {moisture}: Moisture it costs.
texts.climbedUp: The hydra squeezes up through the Passage. There is a great deal of sky up here, and none of it is on her side.
texts.wentDown: Back underground. The heads relax all at once.
texts.exhaled: The heads breathe out. Mist settles round the hydra like an excuse.
texts.noMoisture: Not enough Moisture to breathe mist.
texts.notOnSurface: Mist is for the surface. Down here it is just humidity.
texts.exposed: No mist under her. Everyone can see the hydra, and the sun is unkind. Body -{n} HP.
texts.nightFalls: Night falls. The Order lights its lanterns and sees a little less.
texts.dayBreaks: Dawn. The mist thins as the sun comes up.
texts.windyDay: A windy day. The mist won't last.
texts.shrineOut: The Flame Shrine is out. Mist pours into the cold brazier and stays. {left} still burning.
texts.allShrinesOut: The last Flame Shrine is out. The Order has nothing left to keep burning but its temper.
texts.relightSent: Torchbearers set out with a ladder and a tinderbox to light a shrine again.
texts.shrineRelit: A Flame Shrine burns again. Its mist starts to thin.
texts.crawl: No mist ahead and no Moisture to breathe it: she can only crawl one step.
texts.breathAhead: {n} Moisture to breathe mist on the way
texts.noMovement: Not enough movement left this turn.
texts.patrolOut: A patrol of the Order sets out from {where}, to look for whatever is breathing all this fog.
